name: ThemeData + ColorScheme
summary: Flutter's built-in Material theming system for defining application-wide colors, typography, component themes, light/dark themes, and Material 3 color schemes.
advantages: Built into Flutter and does not require an additional theming dependency
Provides application-wide ThemeData, ColorScheme, TextTheme, and component-specific themes
Material 3 is the default Material style in current Flutter
ColorScheme.fromSeed can generate coordinated light or dark Material color schemes
tradeoffs: Large custom design systems can require substantial manual ThemeData and component-theme configuration
Platform-provided dynamic colors require additional platform integration or a package such as dynamic_color
recommendedFor: Projects that want direct control over app-wide light/dark themes, typography, and component styling
Design systems that can be expressed through ThemeData, ColorScheme, ThemeExtension, and component themes

verification.reason: Current Flutter theming and Material 3 documentation defines the built-in theming model directly.
